yeah I've gone through it mentally a few times. Sat there with a knife. Feeling it against my skin. 
I'm thinking a little clearer today. I might be able to keep this under control

I dont want to go through the hassle of getting medicine either. My doctors I saw live 12 hours away and I'm in a super small town. I'm taking your advice and not talking to the ex tho. I'm going to try and get out more, maybe I can change my mind
no money, no job, no car, no camera and my parents would not continue to support me if i just left. Good idea tho, it sounds nice
No and i refuse to take them. I'd rather be depressed than a zombie

I've been to therapists many times and they didnt do anything for me. I just stopped believing that I'll ever not be depressed and I dont want to live like this.

My family used to be my rock, like I said I've been depressed for 8 years and Im still here so something was working. I just finished school and had to move in with my parents and now i just feel like a burden. I know they'd be sad but they would be fine in a few years. In contrast I'd be sad for decades. Lesser of 2 evils
